description: Owner only: issue a new server-only signing secret for the project's Prod mail webhook endpoint. Earlier secrets stop verifying at once, and receiving stays off until mail_webhook_verify succeeds with the new secret. The secret is returned in this answer only: install it in Prod application secrets without logging it or writing it into files, notes or source. Repeat the same idempotency key after an uncertain response to read the current secret again. Destructive: requires confirmed: true.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: mail_webhook_rotate
